text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoo-hoo!
Let's gooooo! ☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're slowing down! What're you
doing,
girl?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You keep going! Aim for the finish line
and I'll
meet you there!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Party for one? If you say so, sis! Let's
show the
world how we collab!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooohhhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Palmer couldn't keep up the pace
through the breakaway, so they weren't
able to pull off their
double-slay
runaway. Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them hype each other up,
inspire each
other, and truly run wild.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What was that?! It's like I'm absolutely fried, but still kinda hyped. We were wildin' out there, weren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? That was cray cray! Let's
keep the
vibes high and claw our names
all over the G1s! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios sprawl
out on
the grass side by side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A strong wind blows freely in the sky.
Mejiro
Palmer has finally done it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What was that run? That was so incredibly reckless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But at the same time... I've never seen
her scarier.
I think that's the best
Palmer's ever been.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't argue with that. But she caused
such a
commotion both before and
during the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wonder what Grandmother will say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother? She isn't here to watch us
today,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It seems she flew back just in time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: See? She's right there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! Th-th-th-th-that's! It's!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There in the front row stands a certain
imposing
old woman we didn't expect to
see today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why is Grandmother here?! Trainer!
You said
she wasn't coming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You'd better be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to do about it at this
stage.
What's done is done. Mejiro
Palmer's expression
looks strained, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
W-well, it's too late now, right? Not like
I can
pretend it didn't happen, so I
might as well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yo, Grandmama! ☆ Waheeey...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her greeting has about as much force as
a
mosquito's buzz. In response...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she's mad, isn't she? Or maybe it's
just the
light?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait... did she just—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother Mejiro doesn't respond
directly but,
from a distance...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I see the corners of her mouth
turn up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aghhh! That took literal years off my
life, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But y'know... We really did it! We killed
it today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's pulled this off, there's
nothing left
to be afraid of. She can go
anywhere from here.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you really tore up the track.
Yeah, that was one wild run.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What race do you wanna go for next,
Palmster?
Let's coordinate our
schedules!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You mean you'll run with me again?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Will I? I feel like we've gotta run everything together now!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So tell us, Tray-Tray! Where's the next
party?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, she partied the way she couldn't
back at
the spring Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: After the festival... I suppose it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But only when she can run as freely as
she did today, as her true self, even in
prestigious races,
will we really be able
to say she's free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Another" shot? You don't mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, you do. The autumn Tenno Sho,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's a lotta pressure. There's a good
chance
things'll end up the way they did
in spring...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, they won't! Like I'd let that
happen! ☆ I'll
be right there next to you,
so don't you dare
worry about a thing!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If we're together, nothing's gonna stop
us! We're
goin' all the way, girl! ★
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's right! If you're there with me, I
can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their bond is unwavering. No matter how

illustrious the race, together, they're
unafraid.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can cut loose at the prestigious
autumn
Tenno Sho and show everyone
how much she's
grown since the spring.
